link-pick.note: Ambiguous wordings of link-pairs.tsv asked as the link lane asks them (deterministic answers left out). Floor: the October triangulated picks measured 93.5 % right on the judged pairs. Every case comes from link-pairs.tsv rows judged by agent-review-2026-11-13, a model reviewer, not a person: until the owner confirms them, this floor measures agreement with that reviewer.

link-verify.note: Every judged pair of link-pairs.tsv; a false accept is 'same' for a pair judged wrong, near or compound. Every case is judged by agent-review-2026-11-13, a model reviewer, not a person: until the owner confirms them, this floor measures agreement with that reviewer.

line-classify.note: line-labels.tsv; a false accept is a non-ingredient answer for a line that is an ingredient by rule. Of its 180 cases, 60 are judged rule:deterministic-pre-pass, the pre-pass's own earlier answers, and 120 rule:names-a-curated-food; none is judged by a person.

link-gate.note: No model: LinkGate.Check replayed on every pair of link-pairs.tsv judged right, wrong, near or compound, over gate-catalog.tsv. A case agrees when a right pair passes or a wrong, near or compound pair is held; a false accept is a held-to-be-wrong pair the gate lets through; precision is the share judged right among the pairs it lets through. The signature is LinkGate.Signature, so any change to a rule table needs a new record, which needs no host. The pairs are judged by agent-review-2026-11-13, a model reviewer, not a person: these figures measure agreement with that reviewer.

alcohol-context.note: No model: AlcoholLineContext.Read and Refuse replayed on every row of alcohol-context.tsv. A case passes when the line reads the expected sense, allows the food it must allow and refuses the food it must refuse; a false accept is a food the row says must be refused that the sense allows. The signature is AlcoholLineContext.Signature, so any change to a rule needs a new record, which needs no host. Rule-given rows (status ok) must all pass in GoldenAlcoholContextTests; the rows judged by the alcohol-context builder (agent-review-alcohol-context-2026-11-20, status agent) measure agreement with that reviewer.

wording-tiers.note: No model: WordingTiers.Decide (the deterministic tiers and the link gate) on the wording of every pair of link-pairs.tsv judged right, wrong, near or compound, over gate-catalog.tsv and usda-catalog.tsv, with the kept w01 rows of wording-pairs.tsv as the verified wording table; a pair whose wording is itself a w01 row is left out, since the lane never asks the tiers about a wording the table holds. A case agrees when a right pair's food is the one the tiers write or a wrong, near or compound pair's food is not; a false accept is a held-to-be-wrong pair's food the tiers write; precision is the share judged right among the pairs whose food they write. The fixtures hold no trusted aliases and no curated lines, so the alias and head-default tiers are scored only by wording-tiers.tsv. The signature is WordingTiers.Signature (which holds the gate's and the alcohol rules'), so any change needs a new record, which needs no host. The pairs are judged by agent-review-2026-11-13, a model reviewer, not a person: these figures measure agreement with that reviewer.

line-judge.note: The reprocess lane's line judge (OllamaLineJudge, reader B of the roster, mistral-nemo by default). Every judged row of lines.tsv, startup-fills.tsv and line-kinds.tsv gives a right row and a row with its class's defect, asked once as a rebuild to the right row (expected better) and once to the wrong one (expected worse); a false accept is 'better' on a worse case (reprocess.md section 3: at least 95 % agreement, at most 2 % better on a known-worse pair). The record also counts the combined audit check (the judge's 'worse' confirmed by the rule audit ReprocessRuleAudit) on the worse and better cases; the reprocess lane reads those counts as its audit check's score and cannot leave shadow without a current record. Rows judged agent-review-* measure agreement with that reviewer.

repair.note: No person-judged quote cases exist yet; see docs/architecture/golden-sets.md.

prose-rewrite.note: The clean-room prose lane end to end on prose-judge.tsv: the writer (the model scored) writes each recipe of the file through mask, extract, write, the form rules, check v2 and the judge (--check-model, default the roster's reader B), which passes when a rewrite gets through; each planted fault is put through the gate (check v2, then the judge), which passes when it is refused and is a false accept when it is not. The faults are one deterministic edit of a faithful rewrite (rule:construction); the faithful rewrites are written by the prose-lane-v2 builder (agent-review-construction-2026-11-20), so their figures measure agreement with that reviewer. Not required until the operator records it on the staging proof; until a current record for the writer model is committed the lane cannot qualify (ProseLaneGolden.GoldenProblem).

prose-judge.note: The judge of every prose rewrite (the model scored, the roster's reader B) on prose-judge.tsv: a case passes when it finds a faithful rewrite faithful and a planted fault not; a false accept is a planted fault it finds faithful. Planted faults are rule:construction; faithful rewrites are agent-judged (agent-review-construction-2026-11-20), so the score measures agreement with that reviewer. Not required until the operator records it; until a current record for the judge model is committed the lane cannot qualify.

prose-audit.note: The audit check of the prose lane on prose-judge.tsv: the auditor (the model scored, the roster's auditor) reads each row and the judge (--check-model) confirms its flag; a row counts as flagged only when both agree. Its known-bad and known-good flags are the AuditorScore the lane frame corrects the audited error with. Without a current record the lane cannot qualify.

wording-read.note: The two blind wording readers end to end (wordings design 3.1): reader A (the model scored, the roster's reader A) and reader B (--check-model, the roster's reader B) read every row of wording-pairs.tsv (= and !) and every judged pair of link-pairs.tsv whose wording the deterministic tiers leave, on its evidence pack (no lines in the fixtures; candidates from usda-catalog.tsv and gate-catalog.tsv), the refuter clears agreed synonyms, the outcome table and the link gate decide. A case agrees when an = row's food is the one written or a ! row's food is not; a false accept is a judged-wrong food written; precision is the share judged right among the pairs whose food is written. The fixtures carry no nutrient amounts, so two different foods never count as nutrition-equivalent here. Not required until the operator records it on the staging proof; until a current record for the roster's reader A and reader B is committed the read tier cannot qualify (WordingReaderRecords). The pairs are judged by model reviewers (agent-review-*) or by rule: these figures measure agreement with those reviewers.

wording-lexicon.note: The lexicon proposer (wordings design 2.5) on wording-lexicon.tsv: readers A and B read each term with candidates for what it is said to mean, and an entry is written when both propose the same meaning blind and the refuter (reader A's model) finds no reason it is another food. An = row agrees when the entry means the judged food (the folded words of one hold every word of the other); a ! row when no such entry is written, which is otherwise a false accept. Rows are judged by the wording-readers builder from the w01 pairs (agent-review-wording-readers-2026-11-21), a model reviewer: the figures measure agreement with that reviewer. Not required until recorded; until then the lexicon tier cannot qualify.

alcohol-reading.note: The fixed-reading mode of the readers for the alcohol words the rules leave unclear (alcohol design 2.3 and 3, plan A6) on alcohol-readings.tsv: readers A and B each give one reading of each line (wine: table or fortified; cider: sweet or hard; alcohol: drunk or not food; or unsure) and the combination writes a reading only when both agree, neither is unsure and no data rule contradicts it. A row agrees when the reading written is the judged one, nothing is written for an unsure row, or the reading a rule refuses (!code) is not written; any other reading written is a false accept. Rule rows (status ok) are checked without a model in GoldenAlcoholReadingTests; the judged rows (agent-review-wording-readers-2026-11-21) measure agreement with that reviewer. Not required until recorded; until then the alcohol tier cannot qualify.

link-audit.note: The audit check of the link re-check, the wording tiers and the wording readers (plan C0.3): the auditor (the model scored, the roster's auditor phi4) reads 400 known-bad (wrong, near, compound) and 400 known-good pairs of link-pairs.tsv with the same-food judge, and the check model (--check-model, the roster's reader B) re-reads the pairs it flags; a pair counts as flagged only when both find it wrong. A case agrees when a bad pair is flagged or a good one is not; a false accept is a bad pair left unflagged. The record names both models (model, checkModel) and carries the known-bad and known-good flags, which WordingTierAuditRecord gives the lane frame to correct the audited error with (Rogan-Gladen); without a current record for the roster's auditor and reader B no re-check set, wording tier or reader tier can leave shadow. The pairs are judged by agent-review-2026-11-13, a model reviewer, not a person.
